text.p: These are the leading stories in Botswana's independent midweek newspapers, The Sun and The Gazette, on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The permanent secretary for health has admitted that requisition books for drugs have gone missing from the Gaborone Princess Marina hospital.

- The Botswana Mineworkers Union is to take a dispute with the Debswana Diamond Mining Company over the interpretation of the title 'manager' to the High Court. The dispute hinges on the eligibility of 'managers' to join the union.
- McDonald's wants to open in Botswana. In today's GAZETTE they are advertising for a franchisee. Whoever is selected will have to put up US$400,000 says the ad.
